body:
Rule (rules-farm-chores): eggs and milk once per game day per player.
- Player picks up eggs from the coop.
- Player milks a cow (cow stands, chews, tail swishes).

comments.text:
Done: eggs from the coop, milking with the cow chewing.
Leftovers: milk hard to see; eggs pop back at the loop.

short: Collect eggs, milk the cow. OK?
source: Model movements 31 Oct: gap check against the stage briefs
title: Farm chores: eggs and milk
